description: Prototyping and testing skill set covering prototyping strategy selection, usability test planning, heuristic evaluation, A/B experiment design, tree testing, five-second tests, concept testing, and research metrics frameworks. Use when asked to: choose a prototyping approach, plan or run a usability test, evaluate a design with heuristics, design an A/B experiment, run tree testing, validate a concept, assess design quality, define research metrics, calculate sample size, write task scenarios, or build a test plan. Also triggers on: prototype fidelity, clickable prototype, wireframe, lo-fi, usability test plan, think-aloud, Nielsen heuristics, heuristic severity, SUS score, SEQ, HEART framework, sample size, statistical power, p-value, tree test, IA validation, first-click, directness, five-second test, concept test, desirability testing, assumption mapping, or research metrics.
